New body camera footage shows the moments after a Virginia teacher was shot by a 6-year-old student inside the school.
 
ABC News' Andrea Fujii has the story. https://t.co/VeCMKyNUuM

One of the men accused in a "gang rape" at Cornell University is pushing to have New York Attorney General Letitia James thrown off the case, arguing that she "demonstrated a bias and presumption of guilt" through a past social media post. https://t.co/GaOzYOFbvN

Two juvenile humpback whales stranded on sandbars off New York's Fire Island returned to open water, with one helped by rising tides and crews that responded, including the U.S. Coast Guard. https://t.co/CS7JyD7yMo
